tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Before paying an agent-payable API (x402, MPP or L402), check whether it is safe: does it answer reliably, do its payment terms match its listing (no switched or burn wallets, no overcharges), and is the address it asks you to pay one the seller has proven is theirs. Returns verdict ok | caution | a

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: For sellers: check whether an x402 endpoint is listed in Coinbase's Bazaar and, if not, why. Runs Coinbase's public validator (the indexer's own checks), looks the payout address up in Coinbase's merchant list, and adds the Settle Watch's 30-day availability against Coinbase's 99% bar for featured l

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_payment" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
